```
pkcs-12-CRLBag ::= SEQUENCE {
    crlId    OBJECT IDENTIFIER,
    crlValue [0] EXPLICIT OCTET STRING
}
```

The key insight: `_gnutls_x509_read_string` with `ASN1_ETYPE_OCTET_STRING` reads an OCTET STRING field. If the field is wrapped in an explicit tag [0], the ASN.1 module handles it automatically based on the module definition.
